title: Club Med
summary:
Crude oil movements in the Mediterranean are changing
Like the Caribbean and the North Sea, the Mediterranean is a well-known shipping region with significant sources of oil supply as well as demand. Traditionally, a lot of the oil that was produced in the region stayed in the area and short-haul trades on Aframaxes and Suezmaxes tend to dominate movements in the Mediterranean. By and large, that is still the case today.
